plan_a_advantages: Includes a tempo run to improve lactate threshold and running economy.
Features a longer run to build endurance and trail-specific durability.
Provides a more balanced approach to training, incorporating both speed and endurance work.
plan_b_advantages: May be suitable for athletes needing a very light training load or those recovering from injury.
The focus on easy running could be beneficial for building a strong aerobic base if the athlete is new to trail running.
reasoning: Plan A is the better choice for an athlete aiming to become a faster trail runner. While both plans prioritize easy running, Plan A incorporates a tempo run and a longer run, which are crucial for developing speed and endurance respectively. Plan B focuses almost exclusively on easy runs and rest, which is appropriate for recovery or base building, but insufficient for actively improving speed. The inclusion of threshold and long runs in Plan A provides a more comprehensive stimulus for performance gains.
